title: Test French substitution at the budget calibrated on three noisy planted keys
statement: Search French substitution at the pinned budget on ZL, Takahashi and RF, using normal order, glyphs reversed within words and words reversed within lines. Select one key using public-practice compression savings. Report the three independently seeded 2%-noise homophonic control outcomes alongside the selected practice result.
check: One key.json with a declared transliteration, reading_order and search budget. The experiment summary must disclose the best practice savings and the number of passing controls out of three.
